labels.shortDescription: Field access: refusal without settings permission
labels.value: You need the BarnCRM Admin role (the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission) to change field access.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: refusal without Manage Profiles
labels.value: You need the Manage Profiles and Permission Sets permission to change field access.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: set cannot be changed
labels.value: A chosen permission set cannot be changed here. Choose permission sets your organization made. Profiles, groups and packaged permission sets are changed in Setup; BarnCRM keeps its own permission sets up to date itself.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: no set chosen
labels.value: Choose at least one permission set.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: too many sets ({0} = the most sets)
labels.value: Choose at most {0} permission sets for one change.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: nothing added
labels.value: Add at least one field or kind of record to the change.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: too many items ({0} = the most items)
labels.value: One change holds at most {0} fields and kinds of record.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: change unreadable
labels.value: This change could not be read. Clear it and start again.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: unknown object ({0} = its name)
labels.value: {0} is not a kind of record you can change access to.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: not permissionable ({0} = field name)
labels.value: {0} cannot be given or taken: Salesforce decides who sees it.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: read-only field ({0} = field label)
labels.value: {0} can be read but never edited, so it can only be given Read.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: object none with fields ({0} = object label)
labels.value: {0} is set to No Access, so its fields cannot be given access in the same change.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: count changed ({0} = rows now, {1} = rows confirmed)
labels.value: Access changed since the preview: {0} rows would change now, not {1}. Nothing was saved. Preview again.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: too many rows ({0} = rows, {1} = the most)
labels.value: This change would write {0} rows; one change writes at most {1}. Split it by permission set or kind of record.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: nothing to change
labels.value: Every chosen permission set already has this access. Nothing to change.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: refused row ({0} = set, {1} = target, {2} = reason)
Run log apply ({0} by, {1} when, {2} rows, {3} sets, {4} refused)
labels.value: {0} changed field access on {1}: {2} rows changed on {3} permission sets, {4} refused.

labels.shortDescription: Run log undo ({0} by, {1} when, {2} back, {3} kept, {4} refused)
labels.value: {0} undid this change on {1}: {2} rows put back, {3} kept because they changed since, {4} refused.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: change not found
labels.value: This change cannot be found.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: cannot undo
labels.value: This change cannot be undone: it was already undone, or it changed nothing.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: undo window closed ({0} = deadline)
labels.value: This change could be undone until {0}.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: undo kept a row
labels.value: Changed since, kept as it is now.

labels.shortDescription: Field access: unexpected error
labels.value: Field access could not be changed. The Error Log has the details.

labels.shortDescription: Import undo: field access change
labels.value: This is a field access change. Undo it from Change Field Access in Access Explorer.
